name: osgames
what: v3's games workflow, the wrapper on the scoring program; its id is what the games set's Chainlink reporter fixes. The addresses are the deploy's: the reporter and the games set as the deploy script predicted them from the deployer's nonce on 31 Oct 2026 (k + 1 and k + 2), the workflow owner, the secret owner (the same wallet) and the payout wallet. The committed template keeps its placeholders; this spec sets every address over it, and names the owner
